decisive_items: PET scan:- Revealed cardiac granulomatous disease
Patchy late gadolinium enhancement in multiple walls of the heart
Electrocardiogram showing a monomorphic wide QRS complex tachycardia consistent with ventricular tachycardia
response.rationale: Cardiac sarcoidosis best unifies the complete heart block, ventricular tachycardia, dilated cardiomyopathy with patchy LGE, and PET-proven cardiac granulomatous disease; the other candidates are manifestations or nonspecific phenotypes rather than the underlying etiology.

rejected.why: Ventricular tachycardia is an ECG arrhythmia finding, not the underlying infiltrative diagnosis.
Dilated cardiomyopathy describes the structural phenotype but does not explain the PET granulomatous disease and patchy LGE pattern.
Heart failure is a clinical syndrome present in this case but is not the most specific unifying diagnosis.
